Message:
ext4: add some tracepoints in ext4/extents.c

This patch adds some tracepoints in ext4/extents.c and updates a tracepoint in
ext4/inode.c.

Tested: Built and ran the kernel and verified that these tracepoints work.
Also ran xfstests.
